title: Qualify the absolute loss of the frozen PR5687 two-call invoice (no new κ)
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

The frozen two-call invoice in [PR #5687](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5687), Theorem G5, has strictly negative target-minus-paid Gaussian moment for every positive saving parameter. This source-bound paper application settles its previously unestablished absolute sign. The source's positive predecessor-relative improvement remains compatible with this loss.

After canceling common terms, productive and paid rank masses are both 9,416, with productive ranks at least seven and paid ranks at most six. Under the declared tariff, monotonicity gives the exact all-positive-parameter bound in [the source-bound proof](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87b5cfb7d5fefbb08cd7ec264b3cec7728a3c1e1/research/uniform-two-call-invoice-qualification/PROOF.md). No numerical root, new screening method, physical impossibility or κ improvement is claimed.

## Task and overlap

Explicit research assignment: qualify the complete economics before constructing the proposed consumer. Source head is `b3b0fc751d3f5ecdd1498a99a4bfcfa97a0a5b97`; canonical main is `df0137efd35e11b4445734bf612bdd4c7ebc330c`. This PR is stacked on the identical documentation repair commit `475cfff509e3369926c5b2ee258fc8f1f9c3c6a1` from [PR #5703](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5703), which restores the shared CI navigation links. That dependency contributes one documentation file; this submission adds six isolated paper/source files. No workflow or test is weakened.

The exact G5 contract has 224 independent main inputs and two distinct 408-helper banks. [PR #5698](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5698)'s actual-C optimum and [PR #5678](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5678)'s P104 contract are different objects. Their invoices are not combined here. The classical method is already used by [PR #5673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5673), section 4, on another invoice, and by the canonical signed-invoice preflight. Bounded source/discussion checks found no matching exact G5 sign proof; this is not exhaustive novelty.

## Validation

This is an unregistered static proof package. It includes the complete nonnegative paid/target lists, the cancellation and mass calculation, the unchanged primary caller text, a primary method-credit excerpt, exact commit/blob/SHA custody and explicit claim limits. The argument needs no logarithm or numerical power evaluation. Separate local AI reviews cover the mathematical argument and final publication bytes; no independent human or proof-kernel acceptance is claimed.

No source engine, WORD/archive, matrix, native or scientific replay was run. The physical construction, native phases/ROW interface, ordinary work, precision, tape, stock, compiler and outer hypotheses are not independently established here. A compiler route requiring a positive raw moment for these unchanged lists fails this necessary condition; a different tariff, invoice or architecture needs its own argument. Hosted CI is tooling evidence, not physical validation.

## Credit

Credit Dugongue and the retained source authors for the uniform provider, exact two-call endpoint, full invoice and relative improvement; [PR #5673](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5673) and classical signed-invoice comparison for the elementary method; Cao Yifan, Cinna Davis and the native/helper/code/controller/compiler lineage preserved in the primary text. Apache-2.0 notices are retained. Prepared with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance, including separate local AI review.

## Open next questions

Supply one changed endpoint or complete paid bill with independent targets whose gain exceeds the exact deficit and applicable reserve, before construction. A joint raw-code caller needs actual all-width boundary operators, residual corrections, native tariffs and every entrance-target debit; a low owner rank or cheap residual alone is insufficient. The package's [Open next questions](https://github.com/Clear1nsight/integer-mult-bounds/blob/87b5cfb7d5fefbb08cd7ec264b3cec7728a3c1e1/research/uniform-two-call-invoice-qualification/README.md#open-next-questions) states the smallest useful follow-up. No additional construction or numerical scan is justified for the unchanged G5 invoice.
